message:
Trolley assist and battery trolley · Implementation

Critical information is missing

8 critical items open; 12 of 12 without a declared document.

RQ-grid · Electrical supply and capacity
Demand profile, firm capacity, single-line diagram, power quality, protection and connection study.

RQ-duty · Production task and duty cycle
Production target, route, gradient, payload, state durations, shifts and energy per cycle.

RQ-compatibility · Equipment and interface compatibility
OEM specifications, power, voltage, connectors, communication and operating limits.

Insufficient connection or power
Fleet procurement can precede assessment of simultaneous demand and available capacity.
Review: Measure loads and assess connections, protection and management alternatives before procurement.

Unrepresentative duty cycle
Average consumption can hide gradients, travel and charging downtime.
Review: Measure representative cycles and time distributions; compare equal productive tasks.

Works and reviews outside the schedule
Lines, substations, space and project changes require coordinated review.
Review: Prepare the change dossier, responsible parties and authority-specific review path.

Los Pelambres · 2026-02-17 · Pilot and scheduled testing
Trolley assist for haul trucks on ramps.
The source schedules testing; subsequent commissioning was not confirmed here.

Escondida Norte · 2024-07-04 · Environmental filing announced
A DIA filing for trolley infrastructure, a substation and lines was announced by BHP.
The 2024 release does not establish approval or operating status in 2026.

Kristineberg / Rävliden · 2025 · Progress and integration reported
Battery-trolley progress with Boliden and ABB reported by Epiroc.
The annual report does not establish continuous availability or the current complete fleet.

Sources: SEC — Chilean electrical technical rules: https://www.sec.cl/normas-tecnicas-electricas/
